name: tabglutton
description: Devour duplicate tabs and save the keepers into Obsidian. For Zen Browser and Firefox.

scripts.lint:ext: bun run build && bunx web-ext lint --source-dir=dist
scripts.lint: bun run lint:js && bun run lint:ext
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.start: bun run build && bunx web-ext run --source-dir=dist --firefox=/Applications/Zen.app/Contents/MacOS/zen --firefox-profile=./.dev-profile --profile-create-if-missing --keep-profile-changes
scripts.start:console: bun run build && bunx web-ext run --source-dir=dist --firefox=/Applications/Zen.app/Contents/MacOS/zen --browser-console --firefox-profile=./.dev-profile --profile-create-if-missing --keep-profile-changes
scripts.start:fresh: bun run build && bunx web-ext run --source-dir=dist --firefox=/Applications/Zen.app/Contents/MacOS/zen
scripts.start:fresh:console: bun run build && bunx web-ext run --source-dir=dist --firefox=/Applications/Zen.app/Contents/MacOS/zen --browser-console
scripts.start:firefox: bun run build && bunx web-ext run --source-dir=dist --firefox-profile=./.dev-profile-firefox --profile-create-if-missing --keep-profile-changes
scripts.package: bun run build && bunx web-ext build --source-dir=dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign: bun run build && bunx web-ext sign --source-dir=dist --artifacts-dir=web-ext-artifacts --channel=unlisted
